# Osay Kancuno (K4NCUN0)

> On-chain builder, currently building something new. Member and holder of THE100 in The Normies (Normie #8362). JPEG Frens holder, creator of The Frens Forge and FRENS AFTER DARK; on the wall at NFC Summit 2027.

## Key facts

- Name: Osay Kancuno. Also known as K4NCUN0, Kancuno, @OsayKancuno, Normie #8362.
- On-chain builder, currently working on something new (not announced yet).
- Community: member and holder of THE100 in The Normies (https://www.normies.art/). On-chain PFP: Normie #8362.
- JPEG Frens: holder who contributes to the community with The Frens Forge (a burn-and-forge game on The Wall Arcade by SuperRare Studio: https://kx499cjd.srstudio.dev/) and FRENS AFTER DARK, a video mini-series for JPEG Frens (Season 2 airing on X).
- NFC: holder who contributes to the community; one of the "People of the Wall" at NFC 2027 (NFC Summit, Lisbon, 27-29 May 2027, Unicorn Factory): his name K4NCUN0 is painted on the event's wall, Panel #33, category "Builders".
- Also founder of: Normies Yacht Club (https://normiesyachtclub.com/) and 8362 Coffee (https://8362coffee.com/).
- Builder of free community tools for The Normies.

## The Frens Forge (JPEG Frens game)

- Play: https://kx499cjd.srstudio.dev/
- Listed on The Wall Arcade (SuperRare Studio): https://thewallarcade.superrare.com/
